about_the_game:
Ratman is a 1-4 player, online co-op, survival horror game. You and your team of fellow dwarf knights will enter dangerous dungeons that are home to a creature called “Ratman” and try to destroy his food supplies to stop him from attacking your village. Find matches on your quest to burn his cheese, but don't get caught.

In 'Ratman' you will roam around dark medieval dungeons on a mission to destroy the food supplies of a creature that is terrorizing your village. You will get chased through the whole dungeons by an evil mutated Ratman. You have to collect 5 matches in order to burn all 5 food supplies in order to get out of there as fast as possible.

Ratman will look for you in different locations while you search for the items. Play smart and work together. Or never leave the dungeon again.

  • Medieval Horror Experience: Realistic graphics and sounds as well as a minimal user interface ensure a totally immersive experience that will keep you on your toes.

  • Unpredictable AI: Deceiving AI behaviour and movement that will make you think twice.

  • Replayability and Locations: Choose from over 3 different dungeons at launch (with more on the way), each with hiding spots and layouts.

  • Teamwork: Master the dungeons alone or with friends. Play together, investigate together, distract Ratman and help your friends.

  • Co-operate: Play alongside your friends or random people from all over the world with up to 4 players in this co-op survival horror where teamwork is key to your success.

  • Voice Chat and Text Chat: Hear your friends scream in the distance.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 - 64bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 or new-gen i3 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: ATI HD7900 series or NVIDIA equivalent.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space GB available space
  • Additional Notes: This is the lowest tested hardware that could run the game on medium settings.

short_description: Ratman is a 1-4 player online co-op survival horror game. A creature called “Ratman” is terrorizing local dwarfs. You and your fellow brave dwarf knights decide to sneak into his lair in order to burn his supplies. Find matches and burn his cheese stock, but don't get caught by the murderous Ratman!
